## Summary
The main issue is the runtime error message when attempting to run the built jar:  
`no main manifest attribute, in /home/nikog/projects/Mediaplatfrom/target/Mediaplatfrom-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar`  
This indicates that the generated JAR file does not contain a `Main-Class` entry in its manifest and thus cannot be executed directly with `java -jar`.

## Severity
high

## Bugs

### Bug 1: Missing Main-Class Manifest Entry in JAR
- **File:** `/home/nikog/projects/Mediaplatfrom/pom.xml`
- **Category:** build_configuration
- **Language:** general

- **Problem:**  
The Maven build configuration (pom.xml) does not specify the `Main-Class` attribute in the manifest for the executable JAR. This attribute is necessary for `java -jar` to know which class contains the `main` method to launch.

**Buggy code (excerpt from pom.xml):**
```xml
<build>
    <plugins>
        <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>3.13.0</version>
            <configuration>
                <release>21</release>
            </configuration>
        </plugin>

        <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>3.2.5</version>
        </plugin>
    </plugins>
</build>
```

There is no `<maven-jar-plugin>` or configuration to specify the entry point.

**Fixed code (add maven-jar-plugin with main class):**
```xml
<build>
    <plugins>
        <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>3.13.0</version>
            <configuration>
                <release>21</release>
            </configuration>
        </plugin>

        <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-jar-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>3.3.0</version>
            <configuration>
                <archive>
                    <manifest>
                        <addDefaultImplementationEntries>true</addDefaultImplementationEntries>
                        <mainClass>Main</mainClass>
                    </manifest>
                </archive>
            </configuration>
        </plugin>

        <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>3.2.5</version>
        </plugin>
    </plugins>
</build>
```

**Explanation:**  
Adding the `maven-jar-plugin` with the `<mainClass>` element in the `<manifest>` configuration tells Maven to add a `Main-Class` attribute to the manifest file inside the generated jar. This informs the Java runtime about the entry point class when the jar is executed with `java -jar`. In this project, the main class is `Main` (confirmed by the presence of `public static void main` in `Main.java`), so it is specified as `Main`.

---

## Recommendations
- After this fix, run `mvn clean package` to clean and rebuild the jar.
- Then run the jar using `java -jar target/Mediaplatfrom-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar`.
- Consider also including the `maven-shade-plugin` if you want an uber-jar with dependencies included, otherwise ensure dependencies are on the classpath when running.

---

This fix addresses the runtime error due to missing manifest attribute. Other sources appear fine and are covered by decent tests and usage of standard patterns.

explanation.fix_explanation: Ich habe im pom.xml die Konfiguration des maven-jar-plugin ergänzt, damit beim Erzeugen des JARs die mainClass mit dem richtigen Startklassen-Namen angegeben wird. Dies fügt dem Manifest-File des JARs den notwendigen Eintrag hinzu, um beim Ausführen das Hauptprogramm erkennen zu können. Dadurch wird der Fehler behoben, dass die Main-Class fehlt.
explanation.root_cause_explanation: Der Fehler "no main manifest attribute" tritt auf, weil das erzeugte JAR-Archiv keine Main-Class im MANIFEST.MF enthält. Ohne diese Angabe weiß die JVM nicht, welchen Einstiegspunkt (main-Methode) sie beim Ausführen des JARs verwenden soll. Das Maven-Build muss daher so konfiguriert werden, dass der Main-Class-Eintrag im Manifest gesetzt wird.
explanation.side_effects: Beim Packen des JAR wird jetzt ein Main-Class-Attribut ins Manifest geschrieben. Dies kann Auswirkungen haben, wenn das JAR für andere Zwecke ohne Main verwendet wurde, ist aber Standard und notwendig für ausführbare JARs.
